system.description:
Holy Smash. Interact Action: make an Opposed Heart Check against an ally or enemy. If you succeed, the target has Minor Advantage or Major Disadvantage on its next Skill Check, depending on your sermon.

Shaken Faith (Flaw). Meeting a supernatural being (ghost, demon, etc.) calls for a CR 1 Fear Check. Failing makes you Afraid, and your Fear Checks are +1 CR until you are Stable.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.88

automation.onSuccess: The target has your choice of Minor Advantage or Major Disadvantage on its next Skill Check.

automation.note: Opposed: the Director sets the CR from the target's roll. Apply the chosen Advantage or Disadvantage to the target's next Skill Check by hand.

system.flawDescription: Meeting a supernatural being (ghost, demon, etc.) calls for a CR 1 Fear Check. Failing makes you Afraid, and your Fear Checks are +1 CR until you are Stable.

flawAutomation.note: Director: when this character meets a supernatural being (ghost, demon, etc.), call for a CR 1 Fear Check. On a failure they become Afraid, and add +1 to the CR of their Fear Checks until they are Stable again.
